<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
<title>Aura-Weave Companion — Personal Health & Disaster Safety</title>
<script src="https://www.gstatic.com/antigravity/web/dev/tailwindcss.min.js"></script>
<style>
@keyframes breathePulse {
0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.9; }
50% { transform: scale(1.08); opacity: 1; }
}
.animate-breathe {
animation: breathePulse 3.8s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes auraPing {
0% { transform: scale(0.95); opacity: 0.8; }
70%, 100% { transform: scale(1.35); opacity: 0; }
}
.animate-aura {
animation: auraPing 2.5s cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite;
}
@keyframes beaconFlash {
0%, 100% { opacity: 1; filter: brightness(1.4); }
50% { opacity: 0.3; filter: brightness(0.8); }
}
.animate-beacon {
animation: beaconFlash 0.7s infinite;
}
</style>
</head>
<body class="bg-stone-100 text-stone-800 antialiased p-2 sm:p-4 min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center justify-start font-sans">
<!-- TOP DEMO CONTROLS BAR -->
<div class="w-full max-w-md sm:max-w-2xl bg-white/95 backdrop-blur border border-stone-200 shadow-sm rounded-2xl p-3 mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-lg bg-teal-600 text-white flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs">AW</div>
<div>
<span class="font-bold text-stone-900">Aura-Weave Companion</span>
<span class="ml-1 text-[10px] bg-teal-50 text-teal-700 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-teal-200 font-semibold">Personal</span>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Scenarios -->
<div class="flex items-center gap-1 bg-stone-100 p-1 rounded-xl">
<span class="text-stone-500 font-medium px-1.5 hidden sm:inline">Scenario:</span>
<button onclick="setScenario('normal')" id="btn-scen-normal" class="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg font-semibold transition bg-emerald-600 text-white text-[11px]">Calm</button>
<button onclick="setScenario('warning')" id="btn-scen-warning" class="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg font-medium transition text-stone-600 hover:text-stone-900 text-[11px]">Warning</button>
<button onclick="setScenario('critical')" id="btn-scen-critical" class="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg font-medium transition text-stone-600 hover:text-stone-900 text-[11px]">Critical</button>
<button onclick="setScenario('disconnected')" id="btn-scen-disconnected" class="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg font-medium transition text-stone-600 hover:text-stone-900 text-[11px]">No Vest</button>
</div>
<!-- Web Bluetooth Hardware / Telemetry Source Controls -->
<div class="flex items-center gap-1 bg-stone-100 p-1 rounded-xl">
<button onclick="openBleModal()" id="demo-ble-btn" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg font-bold bg-stone-200 hover:bg-stone-300 text-stone-800 text-[11px] flex items-center gap-1 transition">
<span>⚡ Bluetooth Vest</span>
</button>
<button onclick="toggleDataSourceMode()" id="demo-source-btn" class="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg font-bold bg-teal-50 border border-teal-300 text-teal-700 text-[10px] transition" title="Toggle between real BLE and simulated ticks">
🧪 Sim Ticks
</button>
</div>
<!-- Companion Mode Switcher in Demo Bar -->
<div class="flex items-center gap-1 bg-stone-100 p-1 rounded-xl">
<span class="text-stone-500 font-medium px-1.5 hidden sm:inline">Mode:</span>
<button onclick="setCompanionMode('daily')" id="demo-mode-daily" class="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg font-bold bg-teal-700 text-white text-[11px]">Solo / Daily</button>
<button onclick="setCompanionMode('disaster')" id="demo-mode-disaster" class="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg font-medium text-stone-600 hover:text-stone-900 text-[11px]">🚨 Disaster</button>
</div>
</div>
<!-- PHONE CONTAINER -->
<div id="phone-container" class="w-full max-w-md bg-stone-50 border-[6px] border-stone-800 rounded-[44px] shadow-2xl overflow-hidden min-h-[780px] flex flex-col transition-all">
<!-- Phone Status Header -->
<div class="bg-stone-900 text-stone-200 px-5 pt-3 pb-2 text-xs flex items-center justify-between select-none">
<div class="flex items-center gap-1 font-medium">
<span>9:41</span>
<span class="text-[10px] text-stone-400">AM</span>
</div>
<!-- Vest Status Button -->
<button onclick="openBleModal()" id="vest-status-pill" class="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-medium bg-teal-900/80 text-teal-300 border border-teal-700/60 cursor-pointer" title="Click to manage Bluetooth vest connection">
<span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-teal-400 animate-pulse"></span>
<span id="vest-status-text">Vest Connected (84%)</span>
</button>
<div class="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] text-stone-300">
<span>5G</span>
<span>⚡ 84%</span>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Standalone Banner (Shown when disconnected) -->
<div id="standalone-banner" class="hidden bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500/15 via-emerald-500/10 to-teal-500/15 border-b border-amber-200 px-4 py-2 text-xs text-stone-700 flex items-center justify-between">
<div>
<p class="font-bold text-stone-900 text-[12px]">Vest not connected — showing general area safety info</p>
<p class="text-[11px] text-stone-600">Local weather & AQI monitoring active.</p>
</div>
<button onclick="openBleModal()" class="px-2.5 py-1 bg-teal-700 hover:bg-teal-800 text-white rounded text-[11px] font-semibold flex items-center gap-1">Pair BLE</button>
</div>
<!-- App Header -->
<header class="px-5 pt-3 pb-2 flex items-center justify-between border-b border-stone-200/60 bg-white/70 backdrop-blur">
<div>
<div class="text-[10px] font-semibold text-stone-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Thursday, Sep 10</div>
<h1 class="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-stone-900 flex items-center gap-2">
<span>Aura-Weave</span>
<span class="text-teal-600 text-xs font-normal px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-teal-50 border border-teal-200">Companion</span>
</h1>
</div>
<button onclick="switchTab('settings')" class="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-teal-50 hover:bg-teal-100 text-teal-800 flex items-center justify-center border border-teal-200/80 transition cursor-pointer" aria-label="User Profile">
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="w-4 h-4 text-teal-700" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M19 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H9a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/><circle cx="12" cy="7" r="4"/></svg>
</button>
</header>
<!-- COMPANION MODE TOGGLE (Solo / Daily vs Disaster Mode) -->
<div class="px-4 pt-3 pb-1">
<div class="bg-stone-200/80 p-1 rounded-2xl flex items-center text-xs font-semibold shadow-inner">
<button
onclick="setCompanionMode('daily')"
id="app-mode-daily"
class="flex-1 py-2 px-3 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-all duration-200 bg-white text-stone-900 shadow-xs"
>
<span class="text-teal-600">❤️</span>
<span>Solo / Daily Use</span>
</button>
<button
onclick="setCompanionMode('disaster')"
id="app-mode-disaster"
class="flex-1 py-2 px-3 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-all duration-200 text-stone-500 hover:text-stone-800"
>
<span class="text-amber-500">🚨</span>
<span>Disaster Mode</span>
</button>
</div>
</div>
<!-- MAIN SCROLLABLE CONTENT -->
<main class="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 space-y-4">
<!-- ============================================== -->
<!-- DISASTER MODE VIEW (Shown when Disaster Mode is active) -->
<!-- ============================================== -->
<div id="disaster-mode-view" class="hidden space-y-4">
<!-- Disaster Banner -->
<div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-red-600 via-rose-700 to-amber-700 text-white p-3.5 rounded-3xl shadow-lg border border-red-400/50 flex items-center justify-between">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2.5">
<div class="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-white/20 backdrop-blur flex items-center justify-center font-black text-amber-300 text-base">
🚨
</div>
<div>
<div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-black uppercase text-[11px] tracking-wider text-amber-200">
<span>Disaster Mode Active</span>
<span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-amber-400 animate-ping"></span>
</div>
<p class="text-white text-[11px] font-medium leading-tight">
Prioritizing critical life-safety vitals & hazard evacuation
</p>
</div>
</div>
<button onclick="setCompanionMode('daily')" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl bg-white/20 hover:bg-white/30 text-white font-semibold text-[11px] transition border border-white/30 shrink-0">
Daily Mode
</button>
</div>
<!-- EXTRA-LARGE PRIMARY STATUS CARD -->
<div id="disaster-status-card" class="p-5 sm:p-6 rounded-3xl border-2 shadow-xl transition-all duration-300 bg-emerald-950 text-white border-emerald-500">
<div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 mb-2">
<span id="disaster-badge" class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider bg-emerald-500 text-stone-950">
✓ Field Vitals Stable
</span>
<span id="disaster-battery-text" class="text-[11px] font-mono text-stone-300">
Vest: 84% Batt
</span>
</div>
<h2 id="disaster-status-title" class="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-black tracking-tight leading-tight pt-1">
CONTINUE MISSION PACING
</h2>
<p id="disaster-status-sub" class="text-stone-300 text-xs sm:text-sm leading-relaxed mt-2">
Core temperature and respiration are within tolerable operational limits. Monitor hydration as environmental heat peaks.
</p>
</div>
<!-- EXTRA-LARGE HIGH-VISIBILITY CURRENT VITALS -->
<div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
<!-- Core Temp - GIANT -->
<div id="disaster-temp-card" class="p-5 rounded-3xl border-2 shadow-md bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-500">
<div class="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
<span class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-stone-700">
🌡️ Core Body Temperature
</span>
<span id="disaster-temp-zone" class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[10px] font-black bg-emerald-600 text-white">
SAFE (&lt;99.5°)
</span>
</div>
<div id="disaster-val-temp" class="text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-stone-900 tracking-tight my-1">
98.6°F
</div>
<p id="disaster-temp-desc" class="text-xs font-semibold text-stone-700">
✓ Normal thermoregulation. Heat dissipation active.
</p>
</div>
<!-- Respiration - GIANT -->
<div id="disaster-breath-card" class="p-5 rounded-3xl border-2 shadow-md bg-teal-50 border-teal-500">
<div class="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
<span class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-stone-700">
💨 Breathing Rhythm
</span>
<span id="disaster-breath-zone" class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[10px] font-black bg-teal-600 text-white">
RESTING CORRIDOR
</span>
</div>
<div class="flex items-baseline gap-2 my-1">
<span id="disaster-val-breath" class="text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-stone-900 tracking-tight">
15.2
</span>
<span class="text-sm font-bold text-stone-500">breaths/min</span>
</div>
<p id="disaster-breath-desc" class="text-xs font-semibold text-stone-700">
Smooth diaphragmatic pacing. Normal lung ventilation.
</p>
</div>
<!-- Heart Pulse - LARGE -->
<div class="p-4 rounded-3xl bg-white border-2 border-stone-300 shadow-sm">
<div class="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-bold uppercase text-stone-600 mb-1">
<span class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
❤️ Heart Pulse
</span>
<span id="disaster-pulse-badge" class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-stone-100 text-stone-700">
MODERATE PULSE
</span>
</div>
<div class="text-3xl font-black text-stone-900 my-0.5">
<span id="disaster-val-heart">72</span> <span class="text-sm font-normal text-stone-500">bpm</span>
</div>
<p class="text-[11px] text-stone-600">Continuous optical bio-signal telemetry.</p>
</div>
<!-- Inertial State - LARGE -->
<div class="p-4 rounded-3xl bg-white border-2 border-stone-300 shadow-sm">
<div class="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-bold uppercase text-stone-600 mb-1">
<span class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
🏃 Inertial State
</span>
<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-blue-100 text-blue-800">
IMU Sensor Active
